pdf_title: CAD 数据采购需求说明
general_quote: 必须项，任一不满足该件退回
not_pdf_mandatory: A requirement for revolve/loft/fillet or higher-grade complex geometry
A blanket ban on AI generation

rules.quote: 为真实物件
rules.evidence: External source/actual-product evidence matching model hash
rules.criteria: Missing semantic evidence => UNVERIFIED; cannot infer a real complete object from valid geometry

rules.quote: FreeCAD、OpenSCAD、Onshape、Fusion 360、SolidWorks
rules.criteria: PASS accepted software; unsupported reader => UNVERIFIED; other software needs buyer conversion approval

rules.quote: 参数化、带特征历史的建模
rules.criteria: PASS actual non-frozen parametric history; FAIL frozen/imported/dummy-only

rules.quote: 来源 URL 可访问
rules.criteria: FAIL missing URL or explicit HTTP rejection; network uncertainty => UNVERIFIED

rules.quote: 页面内容与交付模型一致
rules.criteria: UNVERIFIED without buyer-recognized semantic confirmation

rules.quote: 作者授权，或 CC0、CC BY、CC BY-SA、MIT、Apache、GPL
rules.criteria: FAIL missing or expressly excluded license; permitted declaration alone => UNVERIFIED for actual authority

rules.quote: 含完整特征历史，无压缩、冻结或哑实体部分
rules.criteria: History compression is interpreted as collapsed history, not standard FCStd ZIP container. PASS complete native history; unsupported => UNVERIFIED

rules.quote: 装配体附全部引用零件，打开无缺失引用
rules.criteria: Not applicable for a verified single-part/no-link object; assembly reader not implemented => UNVERIFIED

rules.quote: 由交付的原生文件直接导出，AP214 或 AP242
rules.evidence: STEP parser/schema and independent geometry comparison
rules.criteria: FAIL missing/corrupt/wrong schema; actual direct-export provenance is separately UNVERIFIED without bound provenance

rules.quote: 8 张，前、后、左、右、上、下
rules.evidence: Decode count and required named views
rules.criteria: FAIL actual image count !=8 or corrupt; recognized naming allows pose diagnostics; unknown filename-to-pose mapping => UNVERIFIED, not an invented filename rejection

rules.quote: 白色背景、单色灰着色、无网格无坐标轴无水印
rules.criteria: FAIL non-gray/non-white-border/empty; absence of all embedded grids/axes/watermarks remains UNVERIFIED

rules.quote: 长边不低于 2000 像素
rules.criteria: PASS max(width,height)>=2000 for each; FAIL smaller

rules.quote: 45 度俯视和 45 度仰视两个等轴测视图
rules.criteria: UNVERIFIED: PDF 45-degree versus strict isometric convention unresolved; no inferred pose PASS from producer metadata

rules.quote: 同一模型 8 张图取景比例一致
rules.evidence: Independent native projected extents and declared common scale consistency
rules.criteria: FAIL internally inconsistent scale evidence; UNVERIFIED if image-derived scale cannot be established

rules.quote: 项目名、软件及版本、作者或来源、来源 URL、许可证、单位制、零件数、特征数、物件描述，字段齐全
rules.evidence: Non-null required values and ID/native agreement
rules.criteria: FAIL missing/null semantic fields or observable ID/body-count contradictions; creator-software version provenance is not inferred solely from reader version

rules.quote: 一个项目一个文件夹，以项目 ID 命名
rules.evidence: Project directory names and unique IDs
rules.criteria: PASS ID folders and metadata IDs agree; FAIL mismatch

rules.quote: 信息表按批次汇总为 CSV 或 Excel
rules.evidence: Parse batch table, ID coverage and required columns
rules.criteria: FAIL absent/corrupt/incomplete/non-null source/license data; PASS complete consistent table

rules.quote: 路径和文件名只用英文、数字、下划线、连字符
rules.criteria: PASS standard extension dots plus permitted stem characters; FAIL others

rules.quote: 体积差异不超过万分之一、外形尺寸差异不超过千分之一
rules.evidence: Fresh native rebuild and independent STEP BRep
rules.criteria: PASS volume relative error<=1e-4 and each size relative error<=1e-3; FAIL exceed. Buyer-run comparison remains external

rules.quote: 强制重建后，特征树无报错、无失败特征
rules.criteria: PASS no errors; FAIL any invalid/error/failed state

rules.quote: 修改任一尺寸或草图约束后能正常重建，无悬空引用
rules.evidence: Enumerate actual independent numerical dimensions; +/-0.25% and restore diagnostic
rules.criteria: Any tested failure => FAIL. Finite pass => UNVERIFIED for universal edits/geometry constraints. No generator test record produces PASS

rules.quote: 每个草图至少 1 个尺寸或几何约束
rules.evidence: Actual sketch inventory and constraint count
rules.criteria: PASS every sketch has >=1 constraint; FAIL empty/no-constraint sketch

rules.quote: 最终实体闭合、无自交、体积大于 0、无零厚度面
rules.evidence: OCCT validity/BOP, closed/positive volume, nonzero face areas
rules.criteria: PASS all; FAIL violated; unavailable kernel test => UNVERIFIED

rules.quote: 文件单位与实际尺寸一致，整体尺寸在 1 毫米到 20 米之间
rules.evidence: mm scale and positive extents; maximum exterior extent 1..20000 mm
rules.criteria: FAIL nominal scale/unit outside documented range; correspondence to actual object and overall-dimension interpretation remain UNVERIFIED

rules.quote: 无空草图、无被抑制的废弃特征、无未使用的参考几何，特征名无乱码
rules.evidence: Actual sketch uses, suppression, names and user geometry
rules.criteria: FAIL observed empty/unused/suppressed/garbled; unsupported user objects => UNVERIFIED; builtin origin excluded

rules.quote: 完整的真实物件，与名称和描述相符
rules.evidence: Named function and external completeness evidence
rules.criteria: UNVERIFIED from synthetic geometry alone; no manufacturing requirements invented

rules.quote: 不是从现成几何、网格或图片逆向生成
rules.evidence: Native frozen/Block/import diagnostics and process evidence
rules.criteria: FAIL explicit reverse provenance; otherwise process-origin/normal-design judgment => UNVERIFIED

rules.quote: 对最终实体有贡献的节点（草图和特征
rules.inputs: Native feature tree and BRep transitions
rules.evidence: Boolean surviving added/remaining removed material; used sketches counted once
rules.criteria: FAIL local supported count<20; candidate>=20 => UNVERIFIED until buyer counter. Never counts constraints/primitive segments/containers/appearances

rules.quote: 步骤数以我方验收管线计算为准
rules.criteria: UNVERIFIED absent trusted buyer result; local count cannot substitute

rules.quote: 同一个模型只改了尺寸、比例、镜像方向，结构没变
rules.evidence: Exact hash duplicates and normalized structural candidates
rules.criteria: FAIL exact duplicate counted twice; topology/size/mirror heuristic alone => UNVERIFIED

rules.quote: 在信息表中标注同系列模型的系列编号
rules.evidence: Series IDs in table and metadata
rules.criteria: FAIL missing table/series ID; PASS structurally consistent records

rules.quote: 本批次和历史全部库存做自动比对，判定结果以我方为准
rules.criteria: UNVERIFIED absent actual buyer inventory comparison; no fabricated zero-duplicate claim

rules.quote: 原始设计需求或规格说明
rules.criteria: FAIL optional credit if original actual requirements absent/incomplete

rules.quote: 原生格式或 PDF，带尺寸标注
rules.evidence: PDF parse/OCR and associative DXF dimension inventory
rules.criteria: PASS readable decoded drawing with observed dimension tokens; no manufacturing tolerance requirement added

rules.quote: 真实照片
rules.criteria: UNVERIFIED/not supplied; synthetic renders are not photos

rules.quote: 设计意图、建模思路、关键尺寸来由
rules.criteria: PASS design notes present; missing external rationale noted

rules.quote: 同一模型的 OpenSCAD 版本
rules.criteria: FAIL optional credit if absent

rules.quote: 作者自己的多角度高质量渲染图
rules.criteria: UNVERIFIED; automated gray views do not prove author provenance/high-quality approval

rules.quote: 使用全局变量、方程式或参数表驱动尺寸
rules.criteria: PASS expressions observed

rules.quote: 同一文件含多个配置，仍只计 1 件
rules.criteria: FAIL optional credit if absent; configurations never increase project count
